clauses.title: The adversarial gate does not re-raise deterministically pre-checked surfaces and enumerates gaps exhaustively
clauses.section: #### Sol-only adversarial invariant payload block (AC-ADVERSARIAL-payload, CL-D29)
requires: those surfaces are pre-checked deterministically: do not re-raise a surface-agreement gap they cover as a finding
enumerate every instance across the target in one result rather than one per round (CL-D63)

clauses.title: The CL-D63 record bounds the fence grammar of the derived-vocabulary checks
clauses.section: ## CL-D63 — Deterministic agreement checks are the first review layer
requires: the fence extractor recognizes CommonMark leaf fences: backtick or tilde runs of three or more, indented up to three spaces, closed by a same-character run at least as long, with nested fence content included
container prefixes such as block quotes and list items, and a general Markdown tokenizer, are outside the declared surface: the checks validate declared blocks and do not render Markdown (CL-D44)
a finding that requires more Markdown grammar than this is not a CL-D63 defect and needs a new owner decision

clauses.title: The derived-vocabulary fixtures pin the source, every declared surface, the denylist, and the payload duty
requires: the vocabulary source matches the packaged agents and the envelope schema
every declared role surface derives from the source
every declared gate-order surface follows the source order
status grammar lines derive from the source
retired phrases do not survive outside their recorded qualification
the Sol-only payload block pre-checks derived surfaces and CL-D63 records the layer
existing role and gate fixtures cross-check the source
the version 1 window and the marker gate vocabulary derive from the source
the role and gate manifest clauses derive from the source
